objective: Build ONIA's AI-video creator strategy using Sergio's creator references, current AI video workflows and Higgsfield production.
desired_result: Create original, high-retention AI education and UGC-style sales videos that turn viewers into DMs, demo requests and client conversations.

sources_used.finding: The strongest references use face + UI + proof examples + bold Spanish captions + high contrast scene changes.
Marketing Studio Video, Supercomputer, Canvas, hooks/settings/avatars and product workflows can support UGC, demos, products and creative campaigns.

sources_used.source: TikTok Creative Center and platform trend sources
sources_used.finding: Native pacing, creator-led proof, concise hooks and platform-native edits remain key for short-form ads.
Shorts/Reels benefit from immediate clarity, original content, visible value and repeatable series.

skills_ranked.application: Create a curiosity, future-shock or skill-ladder hook in the first 2 seconds.
skills_ranked.avoid: Generic openers like 'hoy te voy a mostrar'.

skills_ranked.application: Turn tool usage into a story: impossible result -> tool reveal -> proof -> practical use.
skills_ranked.avoid: Only screen recording with no narrative tension.

skills_ranked.application: Specify subject, action, setting, camera, lighting, pacing, subtitles, proof and negative prompt.
Extract structure and retention devices without copying identity or exact edits.
skills_ranked.avoid: Copying creator phrases, look, music or sequence.

skills_ranked.application: Produce 3 versions per idea: curiosity, education and sales/demo.
skills_ranked.avoid: Generating many variants before knowing the objective.

creator_reference_ranking.use_first_for: premium AI video workflow and Supercomputer positioning
educational skill ladder and authority videos

production_plan_first.video_title: Como vender videos IA en 2026 sin parecer copia
production_plan_first.hook: En 2026, vender videos no sera editar: sera controlar personajes, escenas y pruebas visuales.
script_beats: Problem: mucha gente genera videos bonitos pero no vendibles
Mechanism: Hermes define objetivo, referencia, personaje, escena y prompt
Demo: mostrar Video Lab + Higgsfield + referencia
CTA: escribeme tu rubro y te preparo una idea de video
production_plan_first.higgsfield_prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 AI-video workflow explainer for ONIA. Start with future-shock hook, then show a founder/operator at desk, dark UI overlays, creator reference cards, Hermes Video Lab brief, Higgsfield prompt blocks, storyboard frames turning into a final vertical ad. Spanish captions, fast high-contrast cuts every 2-3 seconds, premium but practical, no copied creator identity, no fake claims.
production_plan_first.negative_prompt: No copied creator likeness, no copied watermark, no fake results, no unapproved logos, no unreadable text, no fake testimonials, no exaggerated income claims.
